title: Page 158
transc:
330 P. M
Jno Horner  Washn June 3rd 1863  
For Austria Astor Horse. We have no 
direct intelligence of Bangor's operations of later
date than in my last telegram. Accounts 
from other sources represent the siege as
vigorously progressing and that Johnston is very
slowly accumulating a force at Canton period
on the other hand we are 
pushing vigorously to run force Bengal 
No apprehensions are entertained here of 
the successful result of his operations 
The arrangements for your car this 
evening have been made up Arabia 
This is to fill up with


O'Reilly 
410 PM St Louis. Wash D. C. June 3. 1863.
For Schofield Alba reports that rebel
force on Arkansas Sandy has been

a texas force to operate in
La. Quarrel Carleton reports evidences of
Indian hostilities in Western Kansas &
western frontier of Dragon This should
be looked to as the new
